say:3:1321108002:1.text: Sorry, I didn't receive any response from Dura... Maybe I wasn't pious enough...

say:6:1321108003:1.text: Please don't lose hope. I can feel your sincerity; it's just that Dura rarely responds to small wishes.
say:6:1321108003:1.source_cn: 请不必沮丧。我能感受到你的虔诚之心，但女神一向很少回应...

say:7:1321108004:1.text: Also, the journey to find the legendary place might itself be a test for you.
say:7:1321108004:1.source_cn: 更何况，找到这个地方的过程，或许正是一种考验。

say:8:1321108005:1.text:
A test...
Do you know anything about it? Could you give me some guidance?!
say:8:1321108005:1.source_cn: 考验……\n您是不是知道点什么？可以给我一些指引吗？！

say:9:1321108006:1.text: Dura above, it's just a mere conjecture of mine; it hardly counts as guidance.
say:9:1321108006:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我只是有一些猜测，算不上是什么指引。

say:10:1321108007:1.text: The legend describes the place as somewhere "the people long to be". It might not refer to a specific place, but rather the most cherished place in each person's heart.
say:10:1321108007:1.source_cn: 正如传说所述，“播散在人心所向的美丽风景”——也许这并...

say:12:1321108008:1.text: The most cherished place in each person's heart?
say:12:1321108008:1.source_cn: 每个人心中的美好之地……？

say:13:1321108009:1.text: Yes. The same scenery can evoke different perceptions. The ocean may be breathtaking, but it has no appeal to those who fear the water. And for pious believers, they long to visit the temples.
say:13:1321108009:1.source_cn: 是的。同一片风景，落在不同的人眼中也是不同的。大海足够...

say:14:1321108010:1.text: When you find yourself in the place you long to be, you'll realize it holds the most beautiful scenery you've been searching for all along.
say:14:1321108010:1.source_cn: 当你去到心中最向往的地方，或许会惊讶地发现，那里就是你...

say:16:1321108011:0.text: But I don't have a specific place I long to be. What should I do?
say:16:1321108011:0.source_cn: 可我没有特别向往的地方，这该怎么办？

say:17:1321108012:1.text: Feeling lost is part of the test. You can get inspiration from the opinions of others.
say:17:1321108012:1.source_cn: 迷茫也是一种考验。这种时候，可以向他人询问意见，说不定...
